title: BrainCraft Challenge
abstract: Evolve a small brain-like network that keeps a simulated agent alive. The BrainCraft Challenge asks for a biologically inspired, rate-based network of up to 1000 neurons that solves a simple decision task with no reward signal. My entry searches the network weights with an evolutionary algorithm, scores each candidate with a handcrafted fitness function and uses multiprocessing to evaluate the population in parallel.
highlight: It scored 12.7 on the task 1 leaderboard with a genetic algorithm, while the top entries, at around 15, are hand-crafted.

demos.alt: Screen recording of the evolved agent navigating the maze
